name: CDE (Demo)
tagline: The Common Desktop Environment — Unix's dusty-blue standard.
description: The Common Desktop Environment unified the Unix workstation world with a single, recognizable look. Its muted dusty-blue palette became the face of Sun, HP, and IBM workstations throughout the 1990s.
